final: SELECT SUM(race_stats.total_points) as combined_total_points, AVG(race_stats.avg_laps) as average_laps_completed, AVG(race_stats.total_points) - (SELECT AVG(total_points) FROM (SELECT SUM(results.points) as total_points FROM results JOIN races ON results.raceId = races.raceId GROUP BY races.name)) as average_excess FROM (SELECT races.name, SUM(results.points) as total_points, AVG(CAST(results.laps AS REAL)) as avg_laps FROM results JOIN races ON results.raceId = races.raceId GROUP BY races.name HAVING SUM(results.points) > (SELECT AVG(total_points) FROM (SELECT SUM(results.points) as total_points FROM results JOIN races ON results.raceId = races.raceId GROUP BY races.name))) race_stats
